question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a green present, Bob has a white present, Claire has a pink present, Dave has a purple present, Eve has a grey present, Fred has a brown present, and Gertrude has a silver present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) green present
(B) white present
(C) pink present
(D) purple present
(E) grey present
(F) brown present
(G) silver present
solution:
Present colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: green, white, pink, purple, grey, brown, silver.
1. Eve ↔ Alice: grey, white, pink, purple, green, brown, silver.
2. Bob ↔ Dave: grey, purple, pink, white, green, brown, silver.
3. Alice ↔ Eve: green, purple, pink, white, grey, brown, silver.
4. Fred ↔ Bob: green, brown, pink, white, grey, purple, silver.
5. Bob ↔ Fred: green, purple, pink, white, grey, brown, silver.
6. Gertrude ↔ Alice: silver, purple, pink, white, grey, brown, green.
7. Eve ↔ Fred: silver, purple, pink, white, brown, grey, green.
Bob has the purple present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
